# Fiscal Positions

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List fiscal positions

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/fiscal-positions`

Retrieve a paginated list of fiscal positions with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: company, country, countryGroup, creator, taxes, accounts | `company` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by fiscal position name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[company_id]` | integer | No | Filter by company ID |  |
| `filter[country_id]` | integer | No | Filter by country ID |  |
| `filter[vat_required]` | boolean | No | Filter by VAT required flag |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `sort` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/fiscal-positions?include=company&sort=sort&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```


## Create fiscal position

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/fiscal-positions`

Create a new fiscal position

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Fiscal position name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `company_id` | integer | Yes | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_id` | integer | No | Country ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_group_id` | integer | No | Country group ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `zip_from` | string | No | ZIP code from. Must not be greater than 10 characters. |
| `zip_to` | string | No | ZIP code to. Must not be greater than 10 characters. |
| `notes` | string | No | Fiscal position notes. |
| `auto_reply` | boolean | No | Auto reply enabled. |
| `vat_required` | boolean | No | VAT required flag. |
| `foreign_vat` | string | No | Foreign VAT. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `taxes` | object[] | No | Tax mappings array. Include id for update, omit for create. |
| `accounts` | object[] | No | Account mappings array. Include id for update, omit for create. |
| `taxes[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `taxes[].tax_source_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `taxes[].tax_destination_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `accounts[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `accounts[].account_source_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `accounts[].account_destination_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/fiscal-positions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Domestic",
  "company_id": 1,
  "country_id": 233,
  "zip_from": "10000",
  "zip_to": "99999",
  "notes": "For domestic transactions",
  "auto_reply": false,
  "vat_required": true,
  "taxes": [
    {
      "tax_source_id": 1,
      "tax_destination_id": 2
    }
  ],
  "accounts": [
    {
      "account_source_id": 5,
      "account_destination_id": 6
    }
  ]
}'
```
